label: champ_0240_system_01
text: Are you ready to face Larry of the Elite Four?

label: champ_0240_fly_01
text: So, you made it this far.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_02
text: I serve as a member of the Elite Four too, yes...\nUnfortunately for me.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_03
text: At my Gym, I use Normal-type Pokémon, since\nI feel they have a lot in common with me.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_04
text: But, well, the boss told me to use a different\ntype here.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_05
text: So if you have any complaints, please take them\nup with La Primera.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_06
text: Anyway, time to get to work.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_07
text: You’re a lot stronger than I recall. No wonder\nLa Primera likes you.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_08
text: Now then... I suppose the final member of the\nElite Four is next.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_09
text: It’s your turn, Hassel...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_fly_10
text: Now, where could he be?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_ground_01
text: Uh... Don’t think he heard you, Larry.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0240_fly_11
text: Come on in, Hassel...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0240_ground_02
text: Larry, you...you may need to speak up just a\nlittle bit more.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0240_ground_03
text: Haaasselll! You’re up next![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0240_dragon_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello there, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
It delights
me
to
see
you here.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0240_dragon_01
text: As for you, Larry... I see you made Rika do the\nshouting again, hm?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0240_ground_04
text: Hassel’s the Elite Four’s last line of defense.\nI can’t wait to see how you’ll take him on![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0240_steel_01
text: It’s super amazing you defeated Mr. Larry![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0240_fly_14
text: ...I get the feeling I’m in for another one of\nHassel’s endless lectures.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
